**Risk flags**
- Single shareholder holds 62.56%
- Only 2 year(s) of financials available  

**Overview**  
Teguh Sinar Food Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company that wholesales frozen food to restaurants. It was incorporated on 26 Oct 2014 and is based in Kuala Lumpur. The firm has a share capital of 2,500,000 and is majority‑owned by a single shareholder (62.56%); three directors are recorded. Reported revenue figures are 18,066,455 and 20,207,092, with equity of 17,316,185 and 18,514,515 respectively. The company has been involved in five legal cases, none as a defendant.
